newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Oct 28.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Fidel Ramos vowed to build more roads and bridges as he inaugurated two projects designed to ease traffic congestion in Metro Manila (MANILA BULLETIN)

- The Philippines and Germany will sign this week a 1.3-billion peso assistance agreement to fund various projects that include development of tourist destinations in remote areas of the country, officials said (MANILA STANDARD)
- The Manila People's Forum said they planned to invite Nobel peace laureate and East Timor bishop Carlos Filipe Ximenes Belo to address a parallel APEC forum on November 24-26

- The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has identified at least three grey areas which the Philippines must closely monitor to ensure healthy macroeconomic fundamentals, including the widening trade deficit and possible risks to the banking system (BUSINESS DAILY)
- Another increase in the prices of diesel next month appears inevitable due to rising petroleum costs in Singapore (BUSINESSWORLD)
- The Social Security System has sought Congressional approval to invest 13.1 billion pesos of its members' money abroad, SSS administrator Renato Valencia said (INQUIRER)
